en.title: Number of Players
en.description:
Count the players who can level up under competition ranking: players with the same score share the same rank, and the rank of the next distinct score equals its position in the sorted order; players with a score of 0 never level up.

The standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges on this site are as defined in this problem statement.
en.input: The first line contains n k (1≤n≤100000, 1≤k≤n), and the next line contains n scores (0≤score≤100).
en.output: Output the number of players whose rank does not exceed k and whose score is greater than 0.
en.explanation: Sort the scores in descending order; an equal score keeps the previous rank, and a different score's rank is its index plus one.
hints: Sort the scores in descending order; an equal score keeps the previous rank, and a different score's rank is its index plus one.
